method_change: Historic England/GOV.UK polygon dataset catalogue metadata -> Historic England official List-entry mapping guidance for legacy pre-April-2011 entries.
exact_blocker: Historic England's official List-entry guidance says pre-April-2011 listed buildings are generally represented by a small blue triangle that may not be centred on the building, whereas post-April-2011 additions are denoted by blue polygons. For already-verified Rougemont Castle List Entry 1104054, first listed 29 January 1953, this guidance does not supply a record-level physical footprint polygon; a different official footprint-publishing source or later mapped amendment is required.
